# Historical scene execution audit

**Provenance.** All citations refer to expanded files under `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/results/r1/sceneevolve_cli/C2/test/`. Their corresponding archive is `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/work/scene_archive/bundles/r1--sceneevolve_cli.tar.gz`; each archive member is `experiments/scene_rsi_pilot/results/r1/sceneevolve_cli/C2/test/` followed by the cited relative file path. Line numbers below are those of the original expanded files.

## Bunk room: commons_163096530

**Generated construction.** Step 003 creates a room from box walls, ceiling, individually colored floorboards and timbers. Three bunk assemblies use separate rods, boxes, balls and rounded pillows for posts, frames, mattresses, guards and ladders. Other assemblies represent a wardrobe, fireplace, leaning radiator and accessories; the fireplace is scaled vertically about a floor pivot and moved sideways. These are code-defined parts and intended placements, not measured proof of contact or image fidelity. [X0873, `commons_163096530/steps/003/build.py`, lines 7–118, 120–208]

**Surface and view intent.** After realization, the script classifies materials by base color and adds generated-coordinate noise, color ramps and bump for wood or plaster; dark near-neutral materials receive metallic settings. It sets a 36 mm lens and sensor, camera at `(2.15,-5.35,1.82)` aimed at `(-0.30,2.35,1.18)`, two area lights, ambient world strength 0.22 and AgX. Its audit comments are author assertions, not independent validation. [X0873, lines 10–12, 210–280]

**Execution and limits.** Steps 002 and 003 each report `ok: true`, null error, empty stderr, 16/16 samples completed, a saved PNG and `scene.blend`; their logged total render-and-save times were 7.80 and 7.40 seconds respectively. This establishes technical completion, not visual success. The task metadata identifies a 512 × 341 reference; it does not establish the rendered image dimensions. No selection, acceptance or image-quality assessment for this room is supplied. [X0872, `commons_163096530/steps/002/result.json`, lines 2–7; X0874, `commons_163096530/steps/003/result.json`, lines 2–7; X0875, `commons_163096530/task.json`, lines 2–5]

## Woodworking shop: commons_199974832

**Construction and revisions.** The final top-level build defines a windowed room, four shelf heights, many composite planes and chisels, wall tools, a foreground bench, kettle, bottle, vise, nail bowl and loose tools. The bowl uses 20 sloped box panels and rim rods with 34 separately modeled nails; additional bench clutter comprises rotated blades and wooden blocks. Earlier step 001 instead used Boolean subtraction for the bowl; step 002 replaced it with positive panel geometry and shortened the side shelf runs. These changes are observable in code, but do not establish physical support or contact. [X0876, `commons_199974832/build.py`, lines 57–189, 236–341, 393–410; X0880, `commons_199974832/steps/001/build.py`, lines 71–82, 320–339; X0882, `commons_199974832/steps/002/build.py`, lines 69–80, 299–337]

The final build initializes node colors from stored diffuse finishes, classifies wood and metal, darkens them, and applies stretched noise, ramp and bump to wood. It specifies a camera at `(0,-3.8,2.10)` aimed at `(-0.08,1.5,1.90)`, 27 mm lens, three area lights of 650, 350 and 180 power, ambient strength 0.30, AgX and exposure 0.15. These are script settings, not independently measured rendered appearance. [X0876, lines 8–10, 412–481]

**Execution, validation and selection.** Step 001 actually completed 16/16 samples in Blender 4.2.10, saved its PNG and blend, and reported no error or stderr. The supplied record reports three executions, CPU rendering, complete status and no runtime error; it does not include the step 003 execution log. [X0881, `commons_199974832/steps/001/result.json`, lines 2–7; X0877, `commons_199974832/record.json`, lines 16, 37–53, 58–86; X0879, `commons_199974832/status.json`, lines 2–3]

`selected.json` records step 3, although the record’s separate `selected` field is null. The record reports valid and structural, material, composite and functional passes for “additional bench clutter,” explicitly limited to structural/edit operability; semantic completeness and support/collision truth are null. Reported similarity metrics include SSIM 0.0604 and overall 0.3920. These numbers and passes are recorded outcomes, not independently validated visual acceptance. No reference or render image was supplied for visual inspection, so a completed but potentially poor reconstruction cannot be conflated with a technical rendering failure. [X0878, `commons_199974832/selected.json`, line 2; X0877, lines 17–36, 56–57]
